Subject: Next steps: technical runthrough (60–90m) — availability & attendees

Hi Claire —

Thanks again for the discovery this morning. Helpful to hear the production constraints and the 95th percentile latency targets you shared. From our side, the best next step is a focused technical runthrough (60–90 minutes) with our infra and model team so we can:

- Walk through a short architecture sketch for serving your fine-tuned model at scale
- Surface quantization and batching trade-offs for your workload
- Collect a concrete checklist we can use to size Dedicated capacity and an estimated cost delta

Can you confirm attendee availability for the following 90-minute windows (PDT):
1) Tue, Apr 2 — 09:30–11:00
2) Wed, Apr 3 — 13:00–14:30
3) Thu, Apr 4 — 08:00–09:30

From our side we'll bring: me (AE), Marissa (Solutions — ML infra/ops), Ben (SE — serving runtime). If you want Ravi (data engineering) and a security engineer on your side, please list them and we can expand the agenda.

I've attached a short pre-call questionnaire to surface the data flow and peak concurrency so we can tailor the runthrough. Also attaching a first-pass agenda; happy to adjust.

If any of the proposed windows don't work, send 2–3 times that do and I'll run a quick poll.

Thanks,

Mina Haddad
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0182

Appreciate the recap and the agenda. We can do Wed, Apr 3 13:00–14:30 PDT — that works for the core team. Please include Marissa and Ben.

Heads up: I'll bring Ravi (ravi@quantifly.ai) from data engineering. He'll want to cover how our streaming ingestion and user profiles map into the model input. Also copying our security lead offline (not on this thread yet) — Claire will follow up with an SSO / data handling question we might want to slot into the agenda.

Perfect — Wed 2028-04-03 13:00–14:30 PDT is tentatively blocked on our calendars. I'll send a calendar invite once we lock the final attendee list.

Quick answers to Claire's questions:
- KMS: Yes — our Private and Dedicated deployments support customer-managed KMS / HSM integrations. We'll have Ben cover the integration flow and what logs/permissions are required.
- Token accounting: we'll attach a short token assumptions sheet to the invite (tokens per sample, average sequence lengths, how inference vs. embedding units were estimated).

Proposed attendees and topics (short):
- Mina Haddad (AE) — mutual action plan / next steps, dependencies
- Marissa Cole (Solutions — ML infra) — architecture, deployment patterns, monitoring
- Ben Carter (SE — Serving runtime) — quantization, batching, kernel selection impacts, KMS integration
- Ravi Shah (Quantifly) — data ingestion and feature shaping
- Claire Brooks (Quantifly) — product priorities and SLOs

Agenda (30/50/10 split):
1) 10 min — brief context & success metrics (Claire)
2) 35 min — architecture walkthrough + model serving options (Marissa + Ben)
3) 20 min — sizing, cost assumptions, and KMS/integration checklist (Ben + Mina)
4) 10 min — next steps & mutual action items

Action items for you (Claire / Ravi) before the call:
- Fill the 2‑page precall questionnaire I attached (helps size concurrency)
- Share a sample input shape (pseudonymized) if possible

Attaching the updated agenda and a short token assumptions note. If the security lead wants to join just add them to the invite — we'll reserve 10 minutes for SSO/data handling Q&A.

Thanks — will send a formal invite in the next 30m.

Mina
